Product Details: Bring the blessings of Lord Ganesha into your home with this exquisite BharatSutras Dhokra Art Brass and River Stone Ganesha Figurine. Crafted using the ancient Dhokra lost-wax casting technique — one of India's oldest and most revered metal casting traditions — this charming idol beautifully combines a natural river stone centre with hand-poured brass to create a truly unique piece of art. The figurine depicts a seated Ganesha in a relaxed, meditative posture, radiating a sense of calm and divine presence. The warm golden hue of the brass contrasts elegantly with the natural texture of the river stone, giving each piece its own distinct character. As a handcrafted item, no two figurines are exactly alike, making yours a one-of-a-kind treasure. Measuring approximately 6.0 cm in height, it is compact yet striking. Ideal for home décor, puja spaces, office desks, or as a thoughtful gift for Diwali, Ganesh Chaturthi, housewarmings, and other special occasions. A timeless celebration of India's rich tribal artisan heritage.
